name: Modern Mills Company
summary: Modern Mills Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of flour, feed, and bran products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers flour under the QAMHATI, Modern Mills, and QOOT & ROOT brands. It also provides livestock, poultry, and bran animal feeds under the Premier brand. In addition, the company engages in wholesale and retail of flour. Modern Mills Company was founded in 1982 and is based in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
